column3: Close to the Hebrew; בְּתוּלָה (“a virgin”) is rendered “a young woman.”
Close to the Hebrew; “iniquity of judges” is rendered “iniquity deserving of judgment.”
Close to the Hebrew; עַד־ אֲבַדּוֹן (“to Abaddon”) is rendered “to destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְכִי־ יִפְקֹד (“visits”) is rendered “punishes.”
The Hebrew “he grew up with me as with a father” is rendered “I reared him as a father,” and NKJV supplies “the widow.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his loins have not blessed me” is rendered “his heart has not blessed me.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּתֵפִי (“my shoulder blade”) is rendered “my arm,” and “from its bone” “from the socket.”
Close to the Hebrew; אוֹר (“the light”) is rendered “the sun.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my hand kissed my mouth” is rendered “my mouth has kissed my hand.”
